pages.text: Research Stations are used to carry out research projects. Each Research Station can work on 1 project, and queuing is not allowed.$(br)Higher-difficulty research requires higher-tier Research Stations. Research Station difficulty limits:$(a)7.9 (Tier 1) $(9)9.9 (Tier 2) $(c)14.1 (Tier 3)

The Database is used to store technologies that have been researched and are currently being researched. Capacity: 20.$(br)Breaking the controller does not preserve the stored technologies.$(br)Devices that use technologies need to be connected to the same network as the Database.
